artifact: GRENDEL HNL single-flavor sensitivity (canonical published curve)
source_run: BC6/BC7 low-mass kaon rerun 2026-07-18: the charged-kaon channel is regenerated with the Pythia 8.315 SoftQCD spectrum + transport survival weight (d_esc=1.5 m nominal, n_pool 300k, seed 42), reusing the central_newgrids_20260623 non-kaon channels (bottom/charm/Bc/Bbaryon/induced_tau/prompt-tau/W-Z) and the same P>100 MeV, exact-100, beta=p/E analysis. Utau and all m_N>0.5 GeV are unchanged.
generated_from: central_newgrids_20260623 non-kaon 4-vectors (symlinked) + regenerated Kmeson (production.decay_engine.generate_kaon_csvs --spectrum pythia --d-esc 1.5 --n-pool 300000 --seed 42), recombined and re-analysed, then spliced into the 2026-07-07 beta=p/E curve at Ue m_N<=0.485 and Umu m_N<=0.38.
correction: Supersedes the 2026-07-07 beta=p/E curve at low mass by replacing the old parametric kaon stub (Tsallis spectrum, sigma_kaon=3.0e11 pb, prompt-at-IP) with the Pythia 8.315 SoftQCD spectrum + charged-kaon transport survival weight (sigma_kaon=6.535e11 pb, d_esc=1.5 m). This weakens the low-mass reach: Ue m_N=0.2-0.485 by x1.71-1.91 (deepest 5.91e-9 -> 1.048e-8 @0.395 GeV), Umu m_N=0.2-0.38 by x1.61-1.82. The Umu peak sensitivity relocates OUT of the kaon window: best reach was 8.40e-9 @0.365 GeV and is now 1.297e-8 @1.5 GeV (D-meson region, unchanged). Utau (m_tau>m_K) and all m_N>0.5 GeV points are unchanged. The dominant kaon-sector systematic (transport d_esc) is quantified in bundle/kaon_desc_band.csv. See prior_correction for the earlier beta=p/E fix.

diagnostic_bundle.status: fully re-derived after the beta=p/E fix; the mass=0.305 GeV Ue/Umu band points were re-derived 2026-07-18 for the kaon rerun (0.305 is the only band mass in the K->lN window). At that kaon-dominated point the FONLL ribbon is omitted (band_lo/hi = NaN, acceptance-MC-noise-limited; see bundle FONLL_MANIFEST.json); the low-mass systematic is the kaon transport band. Otherwise consistent with the published central.
diagnostic_bundle.interpretation: production/decay theory-model diagnostics, not statistical confidence bands; the paper comparison remains central-only

analysis.note_cut: P>100 MeV is the deeper/latest run; the conservative P>600 MeV variant is exact_600.

column_contract.u2_min: lower mixing edge of the excluded island
column_contract.u2_max: upper mixing edge (blank/NaN => open; see u2_max_open)
column_contract.has_sensitivity: False => no excluded island at that mass

high_mass_closure.physics: Island pinches because peak yield ~ sigma*beta*gamma*ctau(U^2=1) ~ sigma*bg/m_N^5 (ctau ~ 1/m_N^5). NOT a B-meson/|Vub| effect: W/Z produce N to 10 GeV but at any probeable mixing a 5-10 GeV N decays mm-m from the IP, not at the 22 m detector. High mass = prompt/near-IP (ATLAS/CMS DV) territory.

Umu.note: peak reach relocated from the kaon window (was 8.40e-9 @0.365) to the D-meson region at 1.5 GeV after the kaon-transport weakening; the low-mass Umu minimum is now ~1.37e-8 @0.350 GeV

consumer: GRENDEL competitor-curves plotting package (digitize/make_plots_three_flavor.py overlays PBC BC7 + HNLimits)
prior_correction: Timing chi2 uses each daughter's true beta=p/E instead of a hardcoded beta=1 (implementation commit 79c7337; canonical publication commit fad3a8b). This is an analysis-stage fix (production unchanged); it imposes a species-dependent effective momentum floor above the 100 MeV track cut. Effect vs the previous publish: no mass points lost, closure unchanged, u2_min degrades modestly (median +3.7/+4.5/+9.0% for Ue/Umu/Utau, worst +33% at low mass).

kaon_transport_band.variable: charged-kaon transport escape length d_esc (CMS material-budget proxy)
kaon_transport_band.affects: Ue m_N<=0.485 and Umu m_N<=0.38 (the K->lN window) only
kaon_transport_band.interpretation: Diagnostic band on the low-mass Ue/Umu lower edge from the dominant kaon-sector systematic. u2_min is monotonic in d_esc (larger d_esc -> more kaon survival -> stronger limit); the [1,3] m spread is roughly +-20-25% around the 1.5 m central. Generated with the same seed (42) across d_esc, so it is a pure transport systematic, not MC scatter. Pending a real CMS material map.
